# YouTube Video Converter & Downloader Project

This is a Next.js web application for converting YouTube videos to MP3 and downloading YouTube videos from their URLs.

## Key Features:
- Modern, responsive UI built with React and Tailwind CSS
- YouTube video to MP3 conversion
- YouTube video downloading in various formats
- Server-side processing with Next.js API routes
- TypeScript for type safety

## Technical Stack:
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- React for frontend components
- Node.js backend APIs

## Development Guidelines:
- Use TypeScript for all new files
- Follow React best practices and hooks patterns
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling (avoid custom CSS when possible)
- Implement proper error handling for video processing
- Use Next.js API routes for backend functionality
- Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Add proper loading states for video processing operations
- Include input validation for YouTube URLs
